```yaml
name: Promote RC to Stable Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      rc_tag:
        description: 'Release Candidate tag (e.g., v3.0.0-rc5)'
        required: true
        type: string

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      stable_tag: ${{ steps.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}
      rc_commit_sha: ${{ steps.validate.outputs.rc_commit_sha }}
    steps:
      - name: Validate RC tag and prepare stable tag
        id: validate
        run: |
          RC_TAG="${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}"
          echo "Input RC tag: $RC_TAG"
          
          # Extract stable version from RC tag
          STABLE_TAG=$(echo "$RC_TAG" | sed 's/-rc[0-9]*//')
          echo "Stable tag will be: $STABLE_TAG"
          
          # Check if RC tag exists
          if ! git rev-parse "$RC_TAG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "Error: RC tag $RC_TAG does not exist"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Get commit SHA of RC tag
          RC_COMMIT_SHA=$(git rev-parse "$RC_TAG")
          echo "RC commit SHA: $RC_COMMIT_SHA"
          
          # Check if stable tag already exists
          if git rev-parse "$STABLE_TAG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "Error: Stable tag $STABLE_TAG already exists"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          echo "stable_tag=$STABLE_TAG" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "rc_commit_sha=$RC_COMMIT_SHA" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  promote:
    needs: validate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.rc_commit_sha }}

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Login to DockerHub
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Retag Docker images
        run: |
          RC_TAG="${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}"
          STABLE_TAG="${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}"
          
          # Retag main image
          docker buildx imagetools create \
            -t grafana/beyla:$STABLE_TAG \
            grafana/beyla:$RC_TAG
          
          # Retag k8s cache image
          docker buildx imagetools create \
            -t grafana/beyla-k8s-cache:$STABLE_TAG \
            grafana/beyla-k8s-cache:$RC_TAG

      - name: Create stable release
        id: create_release
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}
          release_name: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
          body: |
            ## Release Notes
            
            This is the stable release of Beyla. This release was promoted from the validated release candidate `${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}`.
            
            ### Changelog
            <!-- Changelog will be auto-generated -->
            
            ### Assets
            <!-- Binary assets will be copied from the RC release -->

      - name: Copy release assets from RC to stable
        run: |
          RC_TAG="${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}"
          STABLE_TAG="${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}"
          
          # List assets from RC release
          ASSETS_JSON=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            "https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/releases/tags/$RC_TAG")
          
          ASSET_IDS=$(echo "$ASSETS_JSON" | jq -r '.assets[].id')
          
          # Copy each asset to stable release
          for asset_id in $ASSET_IDS; do
            asset_name=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
              "https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/releases/assets/$asset_id" | jq -r '.name')
            
            echo "Copying asset: $asset_name"
            
            # Download asset temporarily
            curl -s -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
              -H "Accept: application/octet-stream" \
              "https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/releases/assets/$asset_id" \
              -o "/tmp/$asset_name"
            
            # Upload to stable release
            curl -s -X POST \
              -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
              -H "Content-Type: application/octet-stream" \
              --data-binary @"/tmp/$asset_name" \
              "https://uploads.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/releases/${{ steps.create_release.outputs.id }}/assets?name=$asset_name"
            
            rm -f "/tmp/$asset_name"
          done

      - name: Create stable git tag
        run: |
          RC_COMMIT_SHA="${{ needs.validate.outputs.rc_commit_sha }}"
          STABLE_TAG="${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}"
          
          git tag -a "$STABLE_TAG" -m "Stable release $STABLE_TAG" "$RC_COMMIT_SHA"
          git push origin "$STABLE_TAG"

      - name: Workflow Summary
        run: |
          echo "## 🎉 Promotion Complete!"
          echo ""
          echo "The release candidate **${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}** has been successfully promoted to stable release **${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}**."
          echo ""
          echo "### Next Steps:"
          echo "- [ ] Publish Helm chart to Artifact Hub"
          echo "- [ ] Update technical documentation"
          echo "- [ ] Announce release in community channels"
          echo ""
          echo "### Operations Performed:"
          echo "- Created stable git tag: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}"
          echo "- Retagged Docker images to stable versions"
          echo "- Copied release assets from RC to stable release"
          echo "- Created GitHub release with release notes"
```
